_provenance.raw_pull_canonical_form: sha256 over: canonical JSON of the catalogue array sorted by productId, newline, then one canonical getCubeMetadata response per line in ascending productId order (json.dumps sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators (',',':')), each newline-terminated, UTF-8
_provenance.normalization: NBSP->space, whitespace runs collapsed, casefold; English names only

maintainer_cross.rule: cubes carrying a dimension whose name matches 'household maintainer' together with any immigrant-vocabulary match at dimension OR member level

_provenance.listing_rule: every cube matching BOTH vocabularies is listed; single-vocabulary and non-matching cubes are counted in class_counts only
